name: Levi
bio: Levi is the third son of Jacob and Leah; Leah hoped that through him her husband would become joined to her, and so named him "Levi," meaning "joined" (Genesis 29:34). Along with his brother Simeon, he avenged their sister Dinah at Shechem, brutally slaughtering every male in the city — an act of violence that led Jacob, on his deathbed, to declare that Levi's descendants would be scattered throughout Israel (Genesis 34; 49:5-7). This prophecy was later fulfilled in an unexpected way, transformed into a blessing — Levi's descendants became the priestly tribe, devoted to serving God and dispersed among the cities of all twelve tribes of Israel, a story told later in Exodus and Numbers.
